decision: Accept bounded month-cell previews as an incremental optimization; not 120 FPS certification

method.scope: UI-state fixture, full-trace paging plus accessibility validation; per-run statistics, no pooled percentiles
method.ordering: Odd repetitions before/after; even repetitions after/before; workload order reversed on even repetitions
method.gesture_proxy: Frames starting in command interval plus 500ms settling; complete durations/deadlines retained
method.preview_tradeoff: At most three combined holiday/event tags; fewer visible tags, overflow opens Day
method.host_activity: iOS native linking overlapped initial captures; device-timestamped command timings retained
